about.description: An embeddable, portable, branchable virtual machine to safely run Agents locally.
about.head: 764d192

name: smolvm v1.18.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Let aarch64 Linux resume a branch source instead of freezing it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1327
* Attach host disks and vhost-user block devices to a machine by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1326
* agent: refresh persistent DNS and retain shutdown receipts by @sgrove in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1328
* Return a directory listing when the files API is asked for a directory by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1330
* Fail a delete that needs confirmation when stdin is not a terminal, instead of reading EOF as a decline and exiting successfully by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1333
* Run the image's own entrypoint for a cached --oci-cache run instead of the bake's no-op placeholder by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1335
* Provision the --oci-cache bake without launching a workload so images without /bin/true can be cached by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1340
* Give a clone a host port the kernel will not reassign before it binds by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1341
* Rebuild libkrun so aarch64 machines can branch again by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1342
* Make incremental checkpoints reusable as a Rust crate by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1344
* Reserve every recorded host port so a clone is never given a stopped machine's port by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1345
* Forward CLI --secret-env/--secret-file secrets to the workload on the oci-cache and pack-ref run paths by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1343
* Save checkpoints without staging a second RAM copy by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1305
* Prepare SmolVM v1.17.0 for release by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1346
* Wait for VM threads to exit before restarting machines by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1347
* Say why a machine on the default network backend shows no interface and cannot ping by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1349
* Pause and resume machines without losing running execution by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1350
* List machines in name order so repeated listings stop reshuffling by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1356
* Allow the path-following getxattr and setxattr so a systemd guest is not killed by seccomp by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1357
* Pin the Nix flake to 1.17.0 with its real release hashes by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1360
* Restore a checkpoint's disk as a copy-on-write layer over a shared base instead of copying it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1359
* Unpack an older image cache's layers on the host once instead of in every machine by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1352
* Give checkpoints a history and let a stored checkpoint restore any generation in it by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1351
* Add --guest-subnet so a guest running Tailscale or another CGNAT VPN keeps its gateway and DNS by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1362
* Checkpoint machines created from a pack and reattach the pack's layers on restore by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1361
* Substitute credentials on the way out instead of exposing them to the guest by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1348
* Bump libkrun to the TSI stream intercept pin and rebuild the bundled libraries by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1368
* Fix packed disk attachment and status broken-pipe VM shutdown by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1369
* Allow writev in the VMM seccomp filter so the credential interceptor is not killed by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1371
* Bump libkrun to complete intercepted TSI connects only after the interceptor reaches the destination by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1372
* Prepare SmolVM v1.18.0 for release by @BinSquare in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1370

## New Contributors
* @sgrove made their first contribution in https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/pull/1328

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/smol-machines/smolvm/compare/v1.16.2...v1.18.0
